mapper.insert: insert into wf_approval_cc (id, approval_instance_id, cc_user_id, cc_by_user_id, read_flag) values (#{id}, #{approvalInstanceId}, #{ccUserId}, #{ccByUserId}, #{readFlag})
mapper.select: select count(1) from wf_approval_cc where approval_instance_id = #{approvalInstanceId} and cc_user_id = #{ccUserId}

select cc.id, cc.approval_instance_id, i.title, d.approval_name as type_name, i.applicant_name_snapshot as applicant, (select t.task_name from wf_approval_task t where t.approval_instance_id = i.id order by t.created_at desc limit 1) as current_node_name, cc.created_at as cc_time, i.business_status, cc.read_flag from wf_approval_cc cc join wf_approval_instance i on i.id = cc.approval_instance_id left join wf_approval_definition d on d.id = i.approval_definition_id and d.del_flag = '0' where cc.cc_user_id = #{ccUserId} order by cc.created_at desc
